elements.label: Metrics
elements.description: The measurable result the customer expects, in their own numbers.

parts.label: Current number
parts.question: What does this cost you today, in hours, money or errors, and how do you measure it?

parts.label: Target they will measure
parts.question: What number would tell you this worked, and by when?

elements.label: Economic buyer
elements.description: The person who can approve the spend, and whether they have engaged with us.

parts.label: Named budget owner
parts.question: Who signs off on a purchase of this size?

parts.label: Engaged directly
parts.question: Could we get 20 minutes with them to check this matches their priorities?

elements.label: Decision criteria
elements.description: What the customer will judge the options on, and which criteria are must-haves.

parts.label: Stated criteria
parts.question: What will you compare the options on?

parts.label: Must-haves ranked
parts.question: If you could only get two of those, which two?

elements.label: Decision process
elements.description: The steps, people and date between now and a decision.

parts.label: Steps and approvers
parts.question: Walk me through what happens between now and a decision: who is involved at each step?

parts.label: Decision date
parts.question: When do you need a decision, and what happens if it slips?

elements.label: Identify pain
elements.description: The specific problem in the customer's words, and why it matters now.

parts.label: Pain in their words
parts.question: What is this problem costing the team today, in your own words?

parts.label: Why it matters now
parts.question: What happens if nothing changes this quarter?

elements.label: Champion
elements.description: A named person on the customer side who wants this and has acted for it.

parts.label: Named champion
parts.question: Who on your side wants this most, and why?

parts.label: Has acted for the deal
parts.question: What would help you make the case internally, and who else should hear it?

elements.label: Competition
elements.description: The alternatives the customer is weighing, including building it or doing nothing.

parts.label: Alternatives considered
parts.question: What else are you looking at, including building it yourselves or doing nothing?

parts.label: How we compare
parts.question: Where do we stand against the other options on your must-haves?
